scenarios.name: Save and reopen a newly created empty part

scenario_steps.name: a new unsaved empty part is active in the MCAD Software
the proposed file name does not already exist in the selected folder
the user accepts the proposed file name in the Save As dialog
the active document tab displays the saved file name
the model browser root displays the saved file name
the user closes that document tab
the user opens the saved file from the same folder
its viewport contains no visible model geometry
its model browser displays the origin and end-of-part marker
